```toml
entrypoint = "main.nim"
run = "nim compile -d:ssl -d:release main.nim && PORT=5000 ./main"

[agent]
expertMode = true

[nix]
channel = "stable-25_05"

[[ports]]
localPort = 5000
externalPort = 80

[workflows]
runButton = "Project"

[[workflows.workflow]]
name = "Project"
mode = "parallel"
author = "agent"

[[workflows.workflow.tasks]]
task = "workflow.run"
args = "Start application"

[[workflows.workflow]]
name = "Start application"
mode = "sequential"
author = "agent"

[workflows.workflow.metadata]
outputType = "webview"

[[workflows.workflow.tasks]]
task = "shell.exec"
args = "nim compile -d:ssl -d:release main.nim && PORT=5000 ./main"
waitForPort = 5000

[deployment]
deploymentTarget = "vm"
build = ["nim", "compile", "-d:ssl", "-d:release", "main.nim"]
run = ["./main"]
```
